body.name: singular joint Gaussian and HAC mapping handle
body.construction: Couple logarithmically separated beta-mixing big blocks to independent blocks, prove Cramér--Wold approximation along covariance-convergent subsequences, control Gaussian selector-boundary strips using only \(\operatorname{Var}(D)\geq\nu\), and studentize each selected ATT direction using its own positive scalar variance rather than inverting the stacked covariance.
